name: Cloud SQL Database Destruction
description: Cloud SQL is Google's managed database. Changing or deleting an instance takes the application’s data with it, or weakens networking and backups so the next step is easier. Like RDS deletion in AWS, this is outage and possible data loss, not a quiet read. Snapshots help only if they still exist. Instance delete and 'authorized networks set to 0.0.0.0/0' are the two changes to treat as emergencies.
mitigations: Rotate credentials if the actor is compromised
